hints: Explain the role of the strong uniform magnetic field in aligning the magnetic moments (spins) of hydrogen nuclei (protons) in the body.
Describe the two spin energy states produced by the magnetic field and the precession of protons at the Larmor frequency.
Explain the role of the radio-frequency (RF) pulse transmitted perpendicular to the main field at the Larmor frequency.
Describe how protons absorb RF energy through magnetic resonance and flip into the higher energy spin state.
Describe relaxation: what happens when the RF pulse stops and protons return to the lower energy equilibrium state.
Explain that during relaxation, the precessing protons emit RF signals that are detected by receiver coils.
Explain the purpose of a non-uniform magnetic field (gradient coils) superimposed on the uniform field.
Connect how the gradient field varies the Larmor frequency across the body, allowing precise spatial localization to form an image.
